milestone: H2-v2 M2e — immutable WS evidence instrumentation
purpose: Build and validate opt-in instrumentation that preserves exact websocket frames and their corresponding normalized H2-v2 collector records before database loading.

raw_frame_evidence.frame_sequence_rule: monotonic per websocket connection starting at 1
raw_frame_evidence.hash_rule: sha256 of exact UTF-8 websocket text frame

tests: disabled mode writes no M2e evidence
single price_change maps to correct provenance
multi-change price_change records share frame provenance and retain distinct change_index
REST resync evidence has null raw-frame provenance
normal production buffer record remains unchanged by instrumentation

acceptance.pass_if: All frozen synthetic validation tests pass and instrumentation is opt-in with no database/schema or normal-buffer semantic change.
acceptance.fail_if: Any required provenance mapping fails, disabled mode changes behavior, or normal production buffer records are modified.

prohibited: post-hoc change of M2e acceptance criteria
next_milestone_if_pass: H2-v2 M2f — fresh raw-to-DB quantity-reduction diagnosis
